# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Glen St. Mary, Prince Edward Island
- **Role:** Farmer and local politician

## Appearance

For many years, Marshall Elliott possessed an extraordinarily long, trailing beard and shaggy hair that gave him a wild appearance. After shaving, he is revealed to be a handsome, neat-looking man with fine features. He dresses smartly once he resumes his normal life.

## Personality

Marshall is stubborn, eccentric, and fiercely principled, adhering strictly to his personal vows regardless of public opinion. Despite his unusual habits and years of self-imposed social isolation, he is inherently kind-hearted, intelligent, and a loyal friend. He possesses a strong sense of humor and takes great delight in politics once he returns to active society.

## Traits

- Stubborn
- Eccentric
- Politically passionate
- Loyal

## Abilities

- Political campaigning and speechmaking

## Goals

- To see the Liberal Party win a government election so he can shave his beard and marry Miss Cornelia Bryant

## History

Marshall Elliott became a local legend in Four Winds after taking a solemn vow during a heated political campaign twenty years earlier, swearing that he would not cut his hair or shave his beard until the Liberal Party won the election. Because the Conservatives remained in power for two decades, Marshall's hair and beard grew to extraordinary lengths, causing him to avoid social gatherings and live as a recluse. During this time, he maintained a quiet devotion to Miss Cornelia Bryant, who refused to marry him while he looked so wild and persisted in his foolish vow. After the long-awaited Liberal victory finally occurs, Marshall immediately visits the barber, shaves his beard, and cuts his hair, transforming back into a handsome, respectable man. Freshly shaven, he finally marries Miss Cornelia Bryant, settling down to a happy domestic life and becoming a close friend and neighbor to Anne and Gilbert Blythe at the Four Winds Light and later Ingleside.

## Background by volume

- Took a vow twenty years prior to a Liberal victory never to cut his hair or shave his beard until the Liberals came to power
- Long loved Miss Cornelia Bryant, though their marriage was postponed indefinitely due to his political vow

## Affiliations

- Liberal Party of Canada — Staunch supporter and campaigner
